0.headline: Amber Enterprises subsidiary IL Jin Electronics files draft papers for Rs 2,500-crore IPO; plans to reduce debt
0.heading: Amber Enterprises subsidiary IL Jin Electronics files draft papers for Rs 2,500-crore IPO; plans to reduce debt
0.intro: The IPO comprises an entirely fresh issue of equity shares by the precision electronics manufacturing services provider.
0.body:
IL Jin Electronics (India), a subsidiary of room air conditioner manufacturer Amber Enterprises, has filed preliminary papers with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to raise up to Rs 2,500 crore through an initial public offering (IPO).

The IPO comprises an entirely fresh issue of equity shares by the precision electronics manufacturing services provider.

The company may also consider a pre-IPO placement of Rs 500 crore before filing the Red Herring Prospectus with the Registrar of Companies (RoC). If the pre-IPO placement is undertaken, the fresh issue size will be reduced to the extent of the amount raised through the placement, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) filed on November 6.

IL Jin Electronics operates 11 manufacturing facilities, including one in Israel, and has four business verticals: electronics manufacturing services (comprising printed circuit board (PCB) assembly and box-build solutions), bare PCB manufacturing, power electronics, and industrial automation.

The company, which claims to be India's largest PCB manufacturer in terms of revenue in FY26, proposes to utilise Rs 1,636 crore of the net IPO proceeds towards debt repayment. Further, Rs 189 crore will be used to purchase certain plant, machinery and equipment for its manufacturing units, while the remaining proceeds will be allocated for general corporate purposes.

The promoters held a 60.34 percent stake in the electronics design and manufacturing company at the time of filing the draft papers, while public shareholders owned the remaining 39.66 percent. Raptor Investments held a 15.37 percent stake in the company.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Financial Performance

IL Jin Electronics has reported strong financial growth in recent years, with its profit nearly doubling to Rs 128.2 crore in the financial year ended March 2026, compared with Rs 66.27 crore in the previous fiscal year.

Revenue during the same period surged 49 percent to Rs 3,268.5 crore from Rs 2,193.7 crore.

For the April-June 2026 quarter, the company reported a profit of Rs 55.7 crore on revenue of Rs 984.8 crore.

The Amber Enterprises-promoted company competes with several listed players, including Dixon Technologies, Kaynes Technology, Syrma SGS Technology, Avalon Technologies and Cyient DLM.

Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors, Axis Capital and Jefferies India have been appointed as merchant bankers to the IL Jin Electronics IPO.

1.headline: Coca-Cola India bottling arm HCCB's parent files DRHP with SEBI for IPO
1.heading: Coca-Cola India bottling arm HCCB's parent files DRHP with SEBI for IPO
1.intro: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings, the parent of Coca-Cola's Indian bottling arm HCCB, has filed its DRHP with SEBI for an IPO comprising an offer for sale of nearly 99.75 crore shares, with a proposed listing on the BSE and NSE in 2027.
1.body:
Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Limited (HCCH), the parent company of Coca-Cola's Indian bottling arm Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages (HCCB), has filed its draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for its proposed initial public offering (IPO) on Friday, November 6.

Moneycontrol had reported last week that the company was set to file its DRHP this week.

The offer is entirely an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 997,461,456 equity shares with a face value of Rs 10 each by Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte Ltd. The shares are proposed to be listed on the BSE and NSE in 2027.

Read More: Coca-Cola India bottler likely to file DRHP this week for $1 billion IPO

“As previously announced, we are exploring a potential IPO of our bottling operations in India and will provide further updates as appropriate,” John Murphy, president and chief financial officer of The Coca-Cola Company, told analysts after announcing the company's September-quarter results last month.

India is the fifth-largest market for the Atlanta-headquartered beverage major and is expected to become its third-largest market globally in the coming years.

For the three-month period ended June 30, 2026, the bottler recorded a 20.46% increase in revenue from operations to Rs 4,310.17 crore, while total sales volume rose 18.61%. EBITDA margin, excluding other income and exceptional items, increased to 17.20% from 13.76% in the same period last year.

Read More: Coca-Cola doubles down on India with affordability, premiumisation push as bottling arm files IPO papers

&nbsp;

HCCH operates through its subsidiary HCCB, primarily in southern and western India. In 2025, Jubilant Beverages acquired a 40% stake in the company. HCCH, which currently holds a majority stake of 60%, will reduce its holding to 45%.

According to the DRHP, “the key select states have a combined population of approximately 616.9 million, include five of India’s eight largest metropolitan cities and have GDP per capita approximately 1.5 times the all-India average.”

The non-alcoholic ready-to-drink (NARTD) beverage market in these states was valued at “Rs 637.3 billion in FY26 and is expected to reach Rs 1,183.2 billion by FY31, representing a CAGR of 13.17%,” the DRHP added.

The company has recently undergone a strategic reorientation, including deeper distribution, portfolio expansion and “optimising the package-price architecture to address portfolio gaps,” the DRHP stated.

Kotak Mahindra Capital Company Limited, Citigroup Global Markets India Private Limited, J.P. Morgan India Private Limited, Morgan Stanley India Company Private Limited, Axis Capital Limited, Goldman Sachs (India) Securities Private Limited and IIFL Capital Services Limited are the book-running lead managers to the IPO.

2.headline: Travomint parent SNVA Traveltech files UDRHP with SEBI for IPO; issue entirely an offer for sale
2.heading: Travomint parent SNVA Traveltech files UDRHP with SEBI for IPO; issue entirely an offer for sale
2.intro: Travomint IPO | The company plans to offer 12.75 crore equity shares through the IPO, comprising entirely an offer for sale.
2.body:
Uttar Pradesh-based SNVA Traveltech, the parent company of Travomint, an online travel booking platform, has filed an updated draft red herring prospectus (UDRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), taking another step towards its proposed initial public offering (IPO).

The company plans to offer 12.75 crore equity shares through the IPO, comprising entirely an offer for sale (OFS), with no fresh issue component, according to the UDRHP filed on November 5.

Consequently, the net proceeds from the offer, excluding offer-related expenses, will go to the selling shareholders and promoters, Alok Kumar Singh and Vivek Kumar Singh.

SNVA Traveltech had initially filed its IPO papers with SEBI through the confidential filing route on April 1, 2026.

Established in 2017, the company operates an online travel platform primarily focused on air ticket bookings. Through its network of travel partners, it provides customers access to real-time inventory from airlines and hotels, enabling them to book flights, hotel stays and other travel-related services.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Financial Performance
According to the F&amp;S Report, SNVA Traveltech recorded a revenue CAGR of approximately 123.26 percent between FY24 and FY26, making it one of its strongest growth periods.

For the quarter ended June 2026, the company reported a consolidated profit of Rs 23.4 crore on revenue of Rs 51.2 crore.

For FY26, the company reported a consolidated profit of Rs 70.8 crore, registering a 73.7 percent increase from Rs 40.8 crore in the previous financial year.

Revenue from operations grew 58.1 percent to Rs 189.1 crore in FY26 from Rs 119.6 crore in FY25.

Equirus Capital and Anand Rathi Advisors have been appointed as the merchant bankers to manage the Travomint IPO.
